commit.subject: LU-20660 ptlrpc: unlock latency_qos->lock on alloc failure
commit.message:
LU-20660 ptlrpc: unlock latency_qos->lock on alloc failure

kick_cpu_latency() returns without dropping the mutex when
the PM-QoS request allocation fails, so anything later taking
that mutex on the same cpu blocks forever.

Fixes: 54a64ea818d9 ("LU-18446 ptlrpc: lower CPUs latency during client I/O")
Signed-off-by: Xiao Yang <xyang@ddn.com>
Change-Id: I8908e94abb316476635da717f571a072526bd3dc
